psychological_meaning: Indigo is often associated with intuition, perception, and higher ideals. It conveys integrity and deep sincerity. This color promotes feelings of justice and fairness. Indigo is a color of devotion, wisdom and justice. Being a mix of deep blue and violet, indigo shares some attributes with each of these colors.
